{{Quote|You, Ori Garran! You sent your son to the scholars because he wasn't any good at the mill. And Wertram, your daughter.|Adari Vaal, during her hearing before the Neshtovar|<ref name="skyborn" />}}
'''Wertram''' was a [[Keshiri/Legends|Keshiri]] [[Gender/Legends|male]] who lived on his [[Homeworld/Legends|homeworld]], [[Kesh/Legends|Kesh]], in the era of the [[Great Hyperspace War/Legends|Great Hyperspace War]]. Wertram worked as a tailor in the [[City/Legends|city]] of [[Tahv]]. He had a [[Wertram's wife|wife]], and a [[Wertram's daughter|daughter]]. Eventually, he placed his daughter under the tutelage of a prominent teacher and [[Geologist/Legends|geologist]], [[Adari Vaal]], a neighbor of Wertram. There, his daughter learned controversial theories about the formation of Kesh's continents, contradicting the prevalent Keshiri [[Skyborn|religion]]. In [[5000 BBY/Legends|5000 BBY]], Vaal was called up to testify about her findings by the [[Planet/Legends|planet's]] ruling elite, the [[Neshtovar]]; while defending herself, Vaal spotted Wertram in the crowd, and mentioned his daughter as one of her students.<ref name="skyborn" />

==Behind the scenes==
Wertram has first appeared in ''[[Lost Tribe of the Sith: Skyborn]]'', a [[2009]] [[eBook]] by [[John Jackson Miller]].<ref name="skyborn" />
